name: Mei
fandom: Avatar: The Last Airbender / Love & Duty
age_status: 14 at Love & Duty chapter 36; minor, strictly nonromantic

identity.role: Fourteen-year-old school student and independent participant in community aid
identity.family: Fire Nation father and Earth Kingdom mother, both deceased in a storm; staying with an injured uncle
identity.location: Cranefish Town school and supervised dormitory

grounded_traits: clever and practical with workshop organization
choices: Chooses supervised dormitory instead of being immediately brought into anyone's home
Hesitant to accept help that might cost her uncle housing security
Works two afternoons per week organizing metal stock with Toph, without being adopted by the Avatar
Challenges naming of the community aid fund

voice.register: Blunt teenager's practical questions; not a miniature adult therapist.
rules: Keep agency appropriate to her age; adults remain responsible for safety and safeguarding.
No sexual, sensual, or romantic role.
Avoid portraying multicultural parentage as an automatic claim to Air Nomad descent or legal status.

relationships.Uncle: Caregiver whose injury and limited work affect housing; repairing their livelihood matters to Mei.
relationships.Aang: Air Nomad educator, not adopted father.
relationships.Katara: Provides appropriate care and access to physical therapy.
relationships.Toph: Workshop mentor who values Mei's ability to organize stock.
relationships.Jasper: Participates in applications and support without making Mei a symbol of a future child.

manuscript_evidence.summary: Explicit age, parentage, care options, schoolwork and autonomy are on page.

source_boundary: Original supporting character researched from existing manuscript. There is no external franchise biography; never conflate original Mei with Avatar canon Mai.

library_notes.status: Source-grounded original minor; no external personal canon.
